exports.normalizeResolvedSecretInputString: Records explicit dummy value/path and trims strings only. No real secret resolution or credential authority executes.

exports.assertOkOrThrowProviderError: Records the synthetic successful response identity and label only. Original status/error behavior is unexecuted.
exports.readProviderJsonResponse: Records response identity/label and returns fresh positive recipe JSON. Original body reader, decoder, limits and deadlines are unexecuted.

exports.ssrfPolicyFromHttpBaseUrlAllowedHostname: Records the source-produced base URL and supplies an opaque named fixture policy. No hostname or network policy algorithm executes.
exports.fetchWithSsrFGuard: Records exact source URL, JSON/headers/timeout/audit fields and returns a synthetic 200 response plus counted release. No network or guard implementation executes.

exports.transcodeAudioBufferToOpus: Records actual source-decoded binary, selected input extension, temp prefix and raw request timeout; returns opaque recipe bytes. No files, FFmpeg or codec executes.

exports.rmSync: Linked solely for complete original module evaluation; never invoked by these ordinary recipes.

globalBoundaries.process: Isolated VM process.env={} only. Original route/key code reads absent fields as provenance; no ambient environment, credential fallback or configured predicate is qualified.
globalBoundaries.fetch: Throwing ambient binding; only the explicitly named synthetic successful guarded-fetch facade is invoked.
globalBoundaries.Buffer: Node native Buffer carries original source-canonicalized synthetic opaque audio bytes; this does not establish a real media format or codec.
globalBoundaries.clock: Actual source numeric helper floors supplied positive fractional HTTP timeouts; raw timeouts reach synthetic media. No real timeout, retry, cancellation or recovery semantics are qualified.

limits: All 58558 pinned tracked blobs/modes are verified before and after; complete original executable modules match pinned Git bytes before TypeScript erasure only.

All nine whole modules evaluate: provider, TTS helpers, directive parser/number, string/record/number normalization, base64 and original blob-runtime. Whole-module evaluation is not all-branch execution.

Original factory, metadata, config, static listVoices and buffered synthesis execute ordinary successful recipes. Original directive parser construction executes; directive dispatch and isConfigured/isConfiguredAsync remain uninvoked.

Original field aliases, provider-object precedence, exact JSON request construction, voice-design/style decision, numeric HTTP timeout helper, successful response extraction and base64 canonicalizer execute.

Original first-nonblank explicit dummy-key helper and source api-key header execute as provenance, not authentication/credential/security qualification. Real secret resolution, guarded HTTP, status checks and JSON readers are named positive synthetic facades.

Synthetic Opus boundary records original decoded MP3/WAV bytes, source input extension/prefix and raw timeout, then returns fixed opaque recipe bytes after successful release. Codec/transcoding/playback/channel delivery remain unqualified.

Static catalog returns all seven ordered source voices without HTTP. Manifest, index, capability catalog and license are complete original data provenance only; plugin activation/registration is not executed.
No dedicated Talk, preparation, streaming or telephony callback is invented. No real HTTP, supplier, codec, runtime dependency or host production implementation executes.
No security/permission/authTLS, negative/error/failure/cancel/crash, mixed, budget/truncation/eviction/threshold/race, real provider or remote MCP execution.
